wire.t: Nov 13: Final Week 10 injury report: A.J. Brown (knee, ankle) and Garrett Wilson (concussion) are questionable in the Breece'sBurdenDeflowered lineup, Kenneth Walker III (groin) is questionable for Lead Nagger, Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) for Stroud of Turin and Jordan Addison (thumb) for Lawrence of a Labia. Patriots-Lions kicks off at 9:30 AM ET Sunday.

Nov 14: rtmcruise added QB Jacoby Brissett at 6:45 AM. Ravens coach Jesse Minter expects Brissett to start Monday night against the Chargers with Lamar Jackson on injured reserve. Matthew Stafford stays the Breece'sBurdenDeflowered starter.

Nov 13: OneSillyBannana cut TreVeyon Henderson, who has been ruled out for Sunday, and added Tyler Higbee, who goes straight into the MY DAD IS DEAD lineup. The Rams ruled out tight end Terrance Ferguson.

Nov 11: Kevin O'Connell would not commit to Kirk Cousins as Minnesota's Week 10 starter after the trade from Las Vegas. Kyler Murray (hamstring) is now officially out. Cousins sits on the Achane in the Membrane bench; Jordan Addison starts for Lawrence of a Labia.
Nov 13: The Texans ruled out Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) and list David Montgomery (groin) as questionable. Both are on the Achane in the Membrane bench, not in the lineup.

Nov 13: Washington beat the Giants 24-21 on Thursday night on a Jayden Daniels touchdown to Stefon Diggs with 57 seconds left. Daniels (20.76) and Diggs (20.3) have Bijan is your daddy up 41.06 to 0.00 on NjigbaR Please!, but Cam Skattebo scored 27.2 with two touchdowns on the FatMikeR bench.

Nov 13: Isaiah Likely had a career-high 127 yards on nine catches, including a 66-yard touchdown. That is 28.7 points for Lead Nagger and the early lead in the Week 10 Highest-Scoring Receiver payout.

Nov 12: ChuckJ10 dropped Antonio Williams at 4:50 PM ET, a commissioner move put him back on Nothing to see here at 5:18 PM, and Williams scored 12.2 with a 31-yard touchdown on Thursday night. Nothing to see here leads Lawrence of a Labia 37.72 to 0.00.

stories.title: Five questionable starters, two of them at 9:30 AM: the Friday injury report hits rtmcruise hardest
stories.dek: A.J. Brown and Garrett Wilson are both questionable in the Breece'sBurdenDeflowered lineup, Kenneth Walker III is questionable for Lead Nagger, and Bill_Buttlicker is starting a questionable Jordan Addison next to a quarterback controversy.
body: The final Week 10 injury reports are out, and five players sitting in Fantasy Addicks starting lineups carry a questionable tag: A.J. Brown (knee, ankle) and Garrett Wilson (concussion) for Breece'sBurdenDeflowered, Kenneth Walker III (groin) for Lead Nagger, Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) for Stroud of Turin and Jordan Addison (thumb) for Lawrence of a Labia. Nobody in a starting spot is listed as out. That is a first for this league and it will not last.

The clock matters more than usual. New England plays Detroit at 9:30 AM ET on Sunday, so A.J. Brown and Amon-Ra St. Brown lock before most of you have found your pants. If rtmcruise or RedDevil904 wants to swap either one, the call has to be made off the early inactives, not the 11:30 list. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered is a 4.5-point underdog to Stroud of Turin, which means both managers are staring at the same game, at the same hour, with the same question. Somebody is going to guess wrong.

rtmcruise did make one move before sunrise on Saturday: Jacoby Brissett off waivers at 6:45 AM. Baltimore head coach Jesse Minter has said he expects Brissett to start Monday night against the Chargers with Lamar Jackson on injured reserve. Matthew Stafford is still the Breece'sBurdenDeflowered starter, so Brissett is a Monday-night insurance policy, and it pairs with Zay Flowers already in the lineup. On Friday, OneSillyBannana added Tyler Higbee and put him straight into the MY DAD IS DEAD lineup; the Rams have ruled out tight end Terrance Ferguson. To make room, OneSillyBannana cut TreVeyon Henderson, who has been ruled out for Sunday.

And then there is Lawrence of a Labia. Bill_Buttlicker trails Nothing to see here 37.72 to 0.00 after Thursday, starts a questionable Jordan Addison, and Addison's quarterback is a mystery: Kyler Murray is out with a hamstring injury, and as of Wednesday Kevin O'Connell would not commit to Kirk Cousins, who Minnesota acquired on Tuesday. The commish is a 10.5-point favorite in a game he is losing, with a receiver who might be catching passes from a guy who learned the playbook on Wednesday. Classic Lawrence of a Labia. Set your lineups by 9:30.

stories.title: FatMikeR benches Cam Skattebo for two touchdowns and 27.2 points, and Bijan is your daddy still leads the league after Thursday
stories.dek: Washington beat the Giants 24-21. Bijan is your daddy has 41.06 on the board, Isaiah Likely put up 28.7 for Lead Nagger, and Antonio Williams scored 12.2 for ChuckJ10 a few hours after being cut.
body: Week 10 is on the board. Washington beat the New York Giants 24-21 on Thursday night when Jayden Daniels hit Stefon Diggs for a 32-yard touchdown with 57 seconds left. Five Fantasy Addicks teams scored on Thursday, and Bijan is your daddy leads the league with 41.06: Jayden Daniels 20.76 and Stefon Diggs 20.3. NjigbaR Please! had nobody playing and sits at 0.00 as a 15.5-point favorite.

Now the bad news for FatMikeR. Cam Skattebo scored 27.2 on the Bijan is your daddy bench with two touchdowns and 122 all-purpose yards on 21 touches. FatMikeR started Bijan Robinson and Zach Charbonnet at running back and left Skattebo sitting. To be fair, Skattebo missed Week 9 and caution is defensible, but the Giants coach said Wednesday he would be full go. Zach Charbonnet now needs 27.2 on Sunday to make that call look smart. Deebo Samuel Sr. is still in the lineup, and Sleeper now lists him as questionable.

ChuckJ10 had the weirdest Thursday in the league. He dropped Antonio Williams at 4:50 PM ET, a commissioner move put Williams back on Nothing to see here at 5:18 PM, and Williams caught a 31-yard touchdown for 12.2 points in the lineup. J.J. McCarthy added 18.12 and Malik Nabers 7.4, so Nothing to see here leads Lawrence of a Labia 37.72 to 0.00. Bill_Buttlicker is a 10.5-point favorite and has not scored a point yet, which is on brand. ChuckJ10 also benched Bucky Irving (bye) and filled the empty spot, dcrabb swapped in the Green Bay defense, and krunkdd filled both Ivefallenandicantgetup holes. Somebody reads this thing.

The receiver payout race is on. Isaiah Likely had nine catches for 127 yards and a 66-yard touchdown, 28.7 points in the Lead Nagger lineup, and leads Highest-Scoring Receiver by 8.4 over Stefon Diggs (20.3). Pudge247 leads Achane in the Membrane 28.7 to 0.00. OneSillyBannana leads Llamageddon 6.4 to 6.2 on Chig Okonkwo against Rachaad White. Everybody else plays Sunday.

stories.title: Week 10 preview: NjigbaR Please! is a 15.5-point favorite, and byes widen two lines
stories.dek: Lead Nagger hosts Achane in the Membrane, Wild Goose Chase is up to an 11.5-point favorite, and every WR and TE slot is a payout ticket.
body: Week 10 is live. NjigbaR Please! (7-2) faces Bijan is your daddy (3-6) and is a 15.5-point favorite. Ivefallenandicantgetup (7-2) draws Wild Goose Chase, the highest-scoring team in the league at 1,185.74 points, and is an 11.5-point underdog after a 3-point nudge for Chris Godwin Jr. and Courtland Sutton being on bye.

Lead Nagger (6-3) plays Achane in the Membrane (3-6) and is favored by 8.5. Lawrence of a Labia (6-3) plays Nothing to see here (2-7) and is favored by 10.5, a 3-point nudge made when Bucky Irving was on bye in the lineup. ChuckJ10 has since benched him, and Nothing to see here leads 37.72 to 0.00 after Thursday. Bill_Buttlicker has a 44-55 all-play record to prove he does not deserve it.

Stroud of Turin (5-4) plays Breece'sBurdenDeflowered (5-4) in the coin flip of the week, 4.5 points apart. Llamageddon (4-5) is a 20.5-point favorite over MY DAD IS DEAD (1-8), the biggest spread of Week 10.

Sleeper lists Josh Jacobs and Jaylen Waddle as out, and Puka Nacua, Patrick Mahomes and Drew Lock as questionable. Check the status before kickoff. Week 10's payout is Highest-Scoring Receiver, so every WR and TE slot is a lottery ticket.

stories.title: krunkdd drops 22 FAAB on Jakobi Meyers to patch a bye-week hole, and Pudge247 buys Tank Dell for 20
stories.dek: The 7-2 co-leader outbid Lead Nagger by 17 dollars, ChuckJ10 finally found a tight end, and OneSillyBannana cut Marvin Harrison Jr. for Reggie Virgil.
body: Waivers cleared overnight and the biggest check came from the guy tied for first. krunkdd paid 22 FAAB for Jakobi Meyers, beating Pudge247's 5 and dstafford4254's 0, and cut Chris Bell to make room. Meyers has 75.6 PPR points in eight games (9.45 a game) and scored 10.5 in Week 9. It is not a luxury buy: Chris Godwin Jr. and Courtland Sutton are both on bye this week, and Ivefallenandicantgetup had two empty lineup spots, one of them the defense, heading into a game against Wild Goose Chase. krunkdd also paid 2 for the Baltimore defense and dropped Philadelphia, which is on bye.

Pudge247 lost the Meyers bid and won Tank Dell for 20 instead. Dell caught 4 balls for 105 yards and a touchdown in Week 9 (20.5 points), so at least Pudge247 bought the guy who just did something. Lead Nagger also cut Devin Singletary, Kalif Raymond and Darius Cooper this week, which is a lot of roster churn for a 6-3 team with the second-most points in the league. Pudge247 has now spent 150 FAAB this season.

ChuckJ10 added Darren Waller for 3 FAAB and J.J. McCarthy for 0 after starting Greg Dulcich (3.4) at tight end in Week 9, and cut Dulcich, Tyjae Spears and Terrance Ferguson (on IR) over the last two days. RedDevil904 dropped Jake Ferguson for Pat Freiermuth, and that one is not a roast: the Cowboys say Ferguson will miss multiple weeks. dcrabb paid 2 for the Green Bay defense because Denver is on bye.

And then there is OneSillyBannana, who cut Marvin Harrison Jr. (4.0 in Week 9) for Reggie Virgil (3.5 in Week 9), swapped Joe Milton for Justice Hill and traded the Chicago defense for Kansas City on the bye. MY DAD IS DEAD is 1-8, a 20.5-point underdog to Llamageddon, and has spent 200 FAAB this year. FatMikeR has spent 0 and is 3-6, so there are two ways to be bad at this.

trades.why: Pudge247 has Joe Burrow and nobody behind him. FatMikeR has Jayden Daniels and Bo Nix (15.68 on the bench in Week 9) and a thin backfield. Emmett Johnson (10.56 on Pudge247's bench) fits.
dcrabb starts Jared Goff and has Brock Purdy. Br0phy has Drake Maye, Jordan Love (36.18 on the bench in Week 9) and Bryce Young, and wants a running back. Rachaad White is the swap.

krunkdd needs wide receiver help behind Chris Godwin Jr. (4.8 in Week 9) and has plenty of backs. Bill_Buttlicker needs a running back who plays. Jordan Addison (4.8) for Javonte Williams works for both.

RedDevil904 now has three tight ends after adding Pat Freiermuth (Dallas Goedert, Kenyon Sadiq, Freiermuth) and a thin backfield. ChuckJ10 has a deep running back room with Chris Rodriguez Jr. (11.2 on the bench in Week 9) and is relying on Darren Waller, a 3-FAAB pickup, at tight end. columns.title: TWO TOUCHDOWNS ON THE BENCH! FATMIKER HAD THE ANSWER IN HIS HAND AND PUT IT IN A DRAWER!
columns.dek: Barry "The Mouth" McCockiner watched Thursday Night Football with the Bijan is your daddy lineup open on his phone and has not sat down since.
body: I NEED A MINUTE. No, I don't. I need to say this RIGHT NOW. Cam Skattebo. Thursday night. Two touchdowns! 122 all-purpose yards! TWENTY-SEVEN POINT TWO fantasy points! And where was he? ON THE BIJAN IS YOUR DADDY BENCH. Sitting there like a guy waiting for a table at a restaurant that's already closed!

And here's what kills me. FatMikeR got the memo! The Giants coach said WEDNESDAY he'd be full go! I'm not asking FatMikeR to read tea leaves! I'm asking him to read a HEADLINE! Instead Zach Charbonnet gets the start and now Charbonnet needs 27.2 on Sunday just to get back to EVEN. Twenty-seven! That's not a running back stat line, that's a JERSEY NUMBER!

Now I'm a fair man. Jayden Daniels put up 20.76. Stefon Diggs put up 20.3. Bijan is your daddy has 41.06 and LEADS THE ENTIRE LEAGUE on Friday morning! Against NjigbaR Please!, the 7-2 co-leader, who has ZERO! So FatMikeR is winning AND losing at the same time! It's a miracle and a crime! It's a MIRACRIME!

Here's my take and I'm STANDING on it: if Bijan is your daddy loses this game by less than 27.2, FatMikeR should have to wear a sign at the draft next year. And if they WIN? Then he got away with it, and getting away with it is WORSE! Because he'll do it again! FOUR STRAIGHT LOSSES AND THE ONE WEEK HE HAS A HEAD START, HE LEAVES HIS BEST PLAY IN THE CAR WITH THE WINDOWS UP! I'M DONE! I'M NOT DONE! NEXT QUESTION!

columns.title: Questionable is not a game plan. Have a backup ready by 9:30, rtmcruise.
columns.dek: Dick Fitzwell on two questionable receivers, one early kickoff and the managers who will set their lineups at halftime of the wrong game.
body: I played linebacker. On Saturday we walked through the call sheet, and if a guy was banged up, the next guy took the reps. Nobody waited until the bus to find out who was starting. That is all I am asking of this league, and somehow it is too much.

rtmcruise has two questionable receivers in the Breece'sBurdenDeflowered lineup: A.J. Brown with a knee and ankle, Garrett Wilson with a concussion. A.J. Brown plays at 9:30 AM ET. If you are a 4.5-point underdog, which Breece'sBurdenDeflowered is, you cannot afford a zero in a starting slot. Look at the inactives, have the backup picked out tonight and make the swap before kickoff. You lost your last two games. Act like it.

RedDevil904, same note. Amon-Ra St. Brown is questionable with the ribs in the same 9:30 game. Stroud of Turin is 5-4 and lost Week 9 with 143.70, the highest losing score in the league that week. One more loss with a hole in the lineup and that becomes a habit.

Credit where it is due: rtmcruise grabbed Jacoby Brissett at 6:45 on a Saturday morning as Monday-night insurance. That is a guy doing his homework. Now finish it. Pudge247, Kenneth Walker III scored 36.3 for you last week and is questionable with a groin. Have a plan. Bill_Buttlicker, you are down 37.72 to 0.00 and your receiver doesn't know who his quarterback is. Don't be soft. Be early.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's seven Saturday lineup moves, ranked from smart to smartest
columns.dek: Oliver Klozoff has studied the Friday injury report from a lawn chair and has some extremely confident advice nobody should follow.
body: Saturday is for thinking. I have a cooler, a folding chair and the Week 10 injury report, and I have reached seven conclusions. Each one is better than the last, which is how you know they are good.

1. bench everyone listed as questionable. There are five of them in Fantasy Addicks lineups: A.J. Brown, Garrett Wilson, Kenneth Walker III, Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jordan Addison. Questionable means the NFL has questions. You should never start a player who has questions. Start a player who has answers, like a kicker. 2. The Patriots and Lions kick off at 9:30 AM ET. That is before brunch. A football game before brunch does not count, so any points scored in it are a bonus.

3. rtmcruise picked up Jacoby Brissett, who plays Monday night. Monday is the last day of the week, which means Brissett has had the most time to prepare. Start him over Matthew Stafford. 4. Bijan is your daddy leads NjigbaR Please! 41.06 to 0.00. FatMikeR should now bench his entire Sunday lineup to protect the lead. You can't lose points you never score. 5. Nothing to see here leads Lawrence of a Labia 37.72 to 0.00, and Nothing to see here is 2-7. Two plus seven is nine. Nine is a winning number. Lock it in.

6. Lead Nagger is an 8.5-point favorite. Favorites are favored. I don't make the rules, I just sit next to them. 7. The smartest move of all: MY DAD IS DEAD leads Llamageddon 6.4 to 6.2 after Thursday. OneSillyBannana should log off Sleeper right now and never look at it again. A 1-8 team that is winning should stay winning, and the only way to guarantee that is to stop watching. That is analytics. Ask Connie Lingus. Actually, don't.

columns.title: Connie Lingus: after one game, Bijan is your daddy is on pace for 1,724 points and the playoffs are a formality
columns.dek: Small sample sizes are only a problem if you are scared of math.
body: I ran the numbers on Thursday night, and I want everyone to stay calm. Bijan is your daddy scored 41.06 points from two players in one game. Each starter scored 20.53 on average. Multiply that by nine starters and you get 184.77, which would be the best score in the league this week. That is not a projection. It is arithmetic.

Now take the season view. Bijan is your daddy has 41.06 points after one of the 14 NFL games this week. My model multiplies that by 42, because 42 is the answer to everything, and lands at 1,724.52 points. NjigbaR Please! currently projects to zero. You cannot beat zero. Nobody ever has.

There is one data point I removed as an outlier: Cam Skattebo's 27.2 on the bench. Bench points do not count, so by definition they are not real. FatMikeR understands this better than anyone, which is why he keeps putting points there. Hiding value is a strategy. Hedge funds do it.

Elsewhere, MY DAD IS DEAD leads Llamageddon 6.4 to 6.2, a 3.2% edge. Over a 14-game season that compounds into a dynasty. Lawrence of a Labia trails Nothing to see here 37.72 to 0.00, which means Bill_Buttlicker has the most room to grow of any manager in the league. I would buy. I would buy everything.

commish.title: Contacts for Your Mom
commish.dek: The two men who run this league, collect your money, and answer to no one.

body: The winningest manager in Addicks history, the man who built this website, and somehow still without a ring. Bill_Buttlicker has 65 regular-season wins, six playoff trips in seven years, and a 2019 final he'd rather not talk about.
He runs the league, sets the payouts, and writes the newsletter that roasts all of you. He also scored 214.54 in 2019 Week 5, the second-highest week in league history. Respect the office.

The first champion in Addicks history. ChuckJ10 won it all in 2019, made the final again in 2021, and went 11-3 as last year's top seed. He has the ring the commissioner doesn't, and he's the second-winningest manager of all time.
This season has been a different story, and the co-commish has been on the receiving end of more than a few A.N.A.L. headlines. Fortunately, he has the authority to overturn none of them.

people.role: Auctioneer · The 13th Man · C.U.C.K. (Commissioner's Unknown Crisis Korector)
body: The thirteenth man in a twelve-team league and the voice of the auction. marco_polo doesn't own a team, which is the only reason nobody has accused him of rigging the bidding.

He opens the bidding, calls the room to order and decides when the hammer drops. As the C.U.C.K., he is also the one called in when the commissioners hit a crisis nobody saw coming. Ask him a question and he answers faster than anyone in the league can think about it. Respect the gavel.
